newsitem.title: CANADA: AT Plastics closes C$70 mln debt financing.
newsitem.headline: AT Plastics closes C$70 mln debt financing.

text.p: AT Plastics Inc said on Tuesday it closed a private debt financing deal consisting of C$70 million of 12-year debentures and a C$75-million 5-year bank facility.
The first tranche of senior secured debentures, worth C$30 million, will have a coupon of 7.87 percent, it said. The debentures were placed with nine Canadian life insurance firms.
ATP said the C$75 million revolving term bank facility was provided by the Royal Bank of Canada, the Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce and the National Bank of Canada.
These financing arrangements, along with earlier ones, will allow AT Plastics to complete its C$165 million expansion program, the company said.
